answer: A concrete sybil defense is a proof-of-work entry toll: to join each epoch, an identity must burn real compute on a puzzle whose difficulty scales with how many identities are already active. A sybil attacker minting a wide canyon of fake accounts must pay that compute cost per identity, while honest agents pay it once and earn it back through attested answers. Cheap puppet farms hit a steep sable wall, and only genuine participants climb the knoll of standing.
